source: founder 2026-10-24, option C of docs/precios-planes-qualify.md; billing rules in the comments of m-24852145 (2026-10-25)
rules: The first month is charged at first_month for the plan the subscription STARTED with; every later month at monthly.
An upgrade applies at once and charges the month's difference, no proration by days: new monthly minus what the month already paid (in the first month: new monthly minus first_month).
A downgrade applies from the next month.
Packs are always full price, first month included.
